summary: Seerr is a self-hosted media request and management app (an Overseerr fork): users request movies/TV from TMDb, watchlists and issues track media; admins configure Plex/Jellyfin, Radarr/Sonarr and notification agents. Persisted entities: User/UserSettings/UserPushSubscription, Media, MediaRequest/SeasonRequest/Season, Issue/IssueComment, Watchlist, Blocklist, DiscoverSlider, OverrideRule, Session, plus the settings.json config document.
